name: software-writer
description: Universal, opinionated skills for writing implementation code, automated tests, and repository documentation.

interface.shortDescription: Write code, tests, and docs with opinionated universal workflows.
interface.longDescription: Adds three skills that guide implementation code (API consultation, dependency shape, footgun checks, comment policy), automated tests (classicist behavior-first workflow), and repository documentation (single-owner surfaces, pointer-file discipline) with per-stack references for Go, Python, TypeScript, and PHP.
defaultPrompt: Write a test for this behavior.
Implement this feature following the writing-code skill.
Update the module README for this change.
